full_judgment:
Md. Akram Hossain Chowdhury, J:- This Rule was issued calling upon the Deputy Commissioner, Chittagong to show cause as to why the Judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 20.01.1991 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, 1st Court and Special Tribunal No.2, Chittagong, in Special Tribunal Case No.237 of 1988, so far it relates to the petitioner, should not be set aside and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. This rule has arisen out of a proceeding initiated against the petitioner in connection with the Judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 20,01.1991, passed by the Special Tribunal No.2, Chittagong, in Special Tribunal Case No.237 of 1988 convicting the accused Ahul Kalam, Md. Nazim (Nadim), S.M. Jahangir and Md. Liton under Section I9A and 19(1'') of the Arms Act along with Section 5 of the Explosive Substance Act 1908 and sentenced each of them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for five years, two years and three years respectively with a fine of Tk.1000/- in each section in default simple imprisonment for 6 months more. 

 3. The prosecution case in brief is that one Sree Gopal Chandra Das lodged an FIR with Pahartoli Police Station on 18.07.1988 accusing I) Abul Kalam @ Zamshed @ Jafar, son of Harun-Or-Rashid @ Badsha Mia 2) Md. Nadim, son of Md. Habib Chowdhury, 3) S.M. Jahangir Chowdhury, son of Jamir Showdagor and 4) Md. Liton, son of Md. Soleman and alleging inter-alia that on 18.07.1988 the accused persons being armed with Local made Pipe gun, Cartridge, Cocktail etc. came by a Baby Taxi in front of the Laundry belonging to the informant started quarrel with regard of their shirt given to the laundry. Hearing such hue and cry other shop keepers came and tried to catch hold of the accused and among them two of the accused persons were caught hold with arms and they were handed over to the police. Hence, Chittagong radar (north) Police Station Case No.5 dated 18.07.1988 was started. 

 4. On that FIR Police started investigation and examined witnesses, visited the place of occurrence and upon finding a prima facie case submitted charge sheet being No.52 dated 20.11.1988 under Section 19A and 19(f) of the Arms Act read with Section 5 of  the Explosive Substance Act against the FIR named accused persons. 

 6. After submission of the said charge sheet the case was sent to the Court of Senior Special Judge, Chittagong who after registering the case being Special Tribunal Case No.237 of 1988 and taking cognizance transferred the same to the Additional Sessions Judge, Court and Special Tribunal No.2, Chittagong for trial. The said Tribunal after receiving the case record framed charge against the said accused persons under the above sections wherein the name of accused No.2 was again shown as:- “মোঃ নাজিম পিং মোঃ হাবিব চৌধুরূ, সাং হারামিঞা (মাঝিরঘাট), থানা- সন্ধীপ, জেলা- চট্টগ্রাম বর্তমানে আগ্রাবাদ সি, ডি, এ কলোনী, থানা-ডবলমুরিং, জেলা- চট্টগ্রাম।” 

 7. At the trial the prosecution in support of their case examined 7 witnesses who were cross-examined by the defence and none of the witnesses have been disclosed the name of the petitioner as accused rather the name of the above noted name as accused in the case. After completion of the trial the learned Judge of the Tribunal upon considering the evidence and materials on record by its Judgment and order dated 20.01.1991 was pleased to find all the charge sheeted 4 accused persons were guilty under Section I9A and 19(f) of the Arms Act, 1878 along with Section 5 of the Explosive Substance Act and sentenced each of them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 5 (five) years, 2(two) years and 3(three) years respectively and also to pay a fine of Tk.1000/- in each section, in default to suffer simple imprisonment for 6 (six) months more 

 8. On that regard the petitioner's further contention is that the petitioner was being a resident of Sandwip within the village-Musapur he was continuing with his normal life there, In the last Union Parishad election of his said locality he was contested-for the post of Chairman in Musapur Union Parishad and his rival candidate was one Momtazul Karim. When the election campaign was going on some reports appearing in the local press stating that a convicted accused identifying the petitioner was contesting in the Election as Chairman in the said Union Parishad, On the basis of that report the Police was trying to apprehend the petitioner in connection with Special Tribunal Case No-237 of 1988. The petitioner apprehending immediate arrest, at the collusion with his rival contestant who was engaged in conspiracy with the police, he came to Dhaka and filed an application for anticipatory bail alleging the aforesaid facts before this Hon'ble Court and a Division Bench of this Court, in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.14 of 1992, was pleased to grant him an anticipatory bail for three weeks with a direction to furnish bail bond to the satisfaction of the Upazila Magistrate, Sandwip, The Honble Judge of this Court while passing the said bail order considered all the facts as to the name of accused as appearing in the said Special Case No.237 of 1988. 

 10. It also contended that the petitioner was came to Dhaka to met his learned Advocate and while he was returning home he was arrested at Kumira within the Shitakunda Police Station and after arrest he was taken in the Chittagong Central Jail and detained there as a convicted accused in connection with the aforesaid Special Case No.237 of 1988. 

 12. No one appeared to support the rule when the case was taken up for hearing, though the case has appeared in the daily cause list with the name of the learned Advocate for the petitioner. However, learned Assistant Attorney General Gazi Md. Mamunur Rashid placed the impugned Judgment and order of conviction and sentence and other materials available on record. 

 13. We have perused the FIR, Charge bisect and other materials annexed with the petition which are on record and gone through the impugned Judgment. It appears from the FIR that one Md. Nadim, son of Md. Habib Chowdhury, Village-Hannia, P.S.-Sandwip, District- Chittagong was shown as accused No.2 of the case and in the charge sheet the investigating officer upon holding investigation categorically stated that he has ascertained the names and address o' the accused persons from their locality and the above named accused 'was again shown as an accused who was sentup in the Charge Sheet. 

 14. In the said FIR and Charge Sheet of the alleged case it appears that in nowhere the name of the present petitioner Md. Abul Khair Nadim alias Abul Khair, son of late Mostafizur Rahman of Village Musapur, P.S. - Sandwip, District- Chittagong was mentioned is an accused of the case, rather the name of one Md. Nadim (in the FIR) Md. Nazim in the Charqesheet), son of Md. Habib Chowdhury, village- Harannia, P.S. Sandwip, District- Chittagong shown as the alleged accused No.2 of the case. 

 Having considered the above facts and circumstances of the case we are of view that the petitioner was not an accused of the aforesaid case and he was wrongly taken into the custody in connection with the aforesaid case as a convicted accused which seems to be an abuse of the process of the Court; as such the proceeding initiated against the petitioner is liable to be quashed. Thus, we find merit in the rule. 

 15. In the result, the rule is made absolute. The initiation of the proceeding against the present petitioner in connection with the impugned Judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 20.01.1991 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 1st Court and Special Tribunal No.2, Chittagong, in Special Case No.237 of 1988, so far it relates to the petitioner, is hereby quashed.
